entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Finally! I've been on hold forever. I want to return this useless jersey I bought. This is ridiculous!
I certainly understand your frustration, and I apologize for the wait. I can definitely look into that return for you. To get started, can I have your name and order number?
The name is Alex Thompson, order number is VF88-12-549. And don't give me the runaround, I want my money back now.

Thank you, Alex. I'm pulling up your order now. I see the ClubFit Jersey. So I can best assist you, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

A preference? Are you kidding me? The jersey is the wrong size! It's so unbelievably tight I can barely get it on. I followed your stupid size chart and it's completely wrong. I want to speak to a manager. This is unacceptable.

I am very sorry to hear that the fit is not right and for the trouble with our sizing chart. I am empowered to handle this for you without needing a manager. It sounds like you need to process an exchange or a return.
You bet I do. I'm about to leave a review everywhere about this. You have one chance to fix this.

I understand completely. Let me just confirm the delivery date... Okay, I see the item was delivered 26 days ago. I'm happy to confirm that you are well within our 90-day return policy. I can process a full refund or an exchange for a different size right now, whichever you prefer.
Wait, really? 90 days? I thought it was shorter. Okay... well, that's... better. An exchange for a larger size would be good, then.

Absolutely. We can definitely get a larger size sent out. And Alex, I see here you're one of our VIP members. For the frustration this has caused with the jersey being too tight, I'd like to add a 20% discount voucher to your account for your next purchase as an apology.
Oh. A 20% discount? Okay. That's... actually very helpful. Thank you, Isaac. I appreciate you fixing this.

It's my pleasure. I've processed the exchange for one size up, and I've just sent the return label for the original jersey to your email. You can expect the new one in 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's all. Thank you for your help.
You're very welcome, Alex. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
